# R. Guertin & Associés — Isabelle Guertin, independent claims adjuster (Montréal)

> Independent claims adjusting practice (cabinet d'expertise en sinistre) founded in 2014 and based in Montréal, Québec. Principal adjuster: Isabelle Guertin (experte en sinistre). Bilingual service in French and English for commercial, personal and liability insurance claims across Greater Montréal and the province of Québec.

The business name is always "R. Guertin & Associés" (short form "R. Guertin & Ass."); it is not translated. The primary language of the site is French (Canada); English pages live under /en.

## Core services

- Commercial claims: loss evaluation and settlement for businesses and commercial property (property damage, business losses).
- Personal claims: residential and personal property claims; independent support for policyholders (public adjusting) seeking a fair settlement under their policy.
- Liability claims: independent investigation and handling of civil liability claims, including municipal civil liability (property damage and bodily injury).
- Damage assessment & technical analysis: causation, scope of damage and review of repair estimates.
- Dispute resolution: claims review and complaint handling under the firm's complaints and dispute-resolution policy.

## Service region

- Greater Montréal (Grand Montréal), including the Island of Montréal
- Laval
- South Shore (Rive-Sud): Longueuil, Brossard and surrounding municipalities
- Elsewhere in the province of Québec on request

## Contact protocol

- Phone: 438 794-1044 (+1 438 794-1044) — preferred for new or urgent claims
- Email: reclamations@rguertin.ca — include policy/claim number, date of loss, address of loss and a short description
- Web form: https://rguertin.ca/#contact (English: https://rguertin.ca/en#contact)
- Office: 4388, rue Saint-Denis, bureau 200, Montréal (QC) H2J 2L1, Canada
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00–17:00 (Eastern Time)
- Languages: French and English
- Personal information is handled under Québec Law 25 and PIPEDA (see privacy statement below)
